new.form.start_failed: The job could not be started
new.intro: Set the test window, the service and the load type. Collecting the metrics and the AI analysis take a few minutes: the progress is shown here and in the archive, and you can close the tab.
new.jobs.title: Active and recent jobs
new.params.llm_hint: Without the AI analysis the report holds only the metric charts.
new.params.report_language_hint: The report will be in the installation's report language, {language} (Settings → Appearance).
new.progress.job_link: Link to this job (you can come back later)
new.progress.not_found: Job not found: the server may have restarted before it saved the status. Check the archive.
new.progress.title: Building the report
new.range.empty: Set the start and the end of the test or pick a quick period.
new.range.long: Window {duration}: long intervals take longer to process and are aggregated more coarsely.
new.range.order: The end must be later than the start.
new.service.empty: Add a service in Settings → Services, then reload the page.
new.service.hint: The list of services is set in Settings → Services.
new.target.hint: The web report is always available. The Confluence option also copies the template page from the service settings and shows the same collection and analysis stages. The report job downloads the Grafana charts and Loki logs for that page itself.
new.target.label: Where to publish the report
new.test_type.hint: The test type sets the programmatic analysis and the AI instructions: finding the maximum, holding the load, the response to spikes or the saturation point.
new.test_type.required: Choose a test type: the analysis instructions depend on it.
new.test_type.soak_desc: Stability under sustained load: metric drift, memory leaks, growing queues.
new.test_type.spike_desc: Response to a sharp rise of the load: latency overshoot and recovery time.
new.test_type.step_desc: Finds the last stable load step and the degradation point; max RPS is taken from the step, not from the peak.
new.test_type.stress_desc: Behaviour beyond the design capacity: the failure point and the limiting resource.
